name: tasklings-supabase
description: Pins the Supabase CLI and Deno used locally and in CI.

scripts.test:functions: cd functions && deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check */index.ts tests/*.ts && deno test --allow-read=. --allow-env && npm run -s bundle:check
scripts.bundle:check: cd functions && deno bundle --import-map deno.json --output /dev/null process-capture/index.ts
